decks.domain: Passing, night driving and age-related driving

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide permits passing to the right where at least _____ lanes carry traffic in the same direction.
cards.back: The guide permits passing to the right where at least two lanes carry traffic in the same direction.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do _____ leave the roadway and use the shoulder to pass, even if the shoulder is paved.
cards.back: Do not leave the roadway and use the shoulder to pass, even if the shoulder is paved.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A driver being passed on the _____ might not see the passing vehicle and could move into its lane.
cards.back: A driver being passed on the right might not see the passing vehicle and could move into its lane.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: On a multilane roadway, the far-_____ lane is intended for passing slower traffic.
cards.back: On a multilane roadway, the far-left lane is intended for passing slower traffic.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not approach closely _____ a vehicle in preparation for passing because it blocks the forward view.
cards.back: Do not approach closely behind a vehicle in preparation for passing because it blocks the forward view.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Wait at a _____ distance until the road ahead can be seen far enough to judge a pass safely.
cards.back: Wait at a safe distance until the road ahead can be seen far enough to judge a pass safely.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide advises against attempting a pass when an opposing vehicle is _____ .
cards.back: The guide advises against attempting a pass when an opposing vehicle is visible.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Before passing, check mirrors and _____ to make sure another vehicle is not already overtaking.
cards.back: Before passing, check mirrors and blind spots to make sure another vehicle is not already overtaking.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Signal _____ moving out to pass and check for vehicles entering from side roads or driveways.
cards.back: Signal before moving out to pass and check for vehicles entering from side roads or driveways.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Keep watching _____ and avoid drifting toward the vehicle being passed.
cards.back: Keep watching ahead and avoid drifting toward the vehicle being passed.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Before returning to the lane, _____ until the front of the passed vehicle can be seen in the rear-view mirror.
cards.back: Before returning to the lane, wait until the front of the passed vehicle can be seen in the rear-view mirror.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Signal again _____ returning to the original lane after a pass.
cards.back: Signal again before returning to the original lane after a pass.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When another _____ is passing, make the maneuver easier by reducing speed slightly.
cards.back: When another vehicle is passing, make the maneuver easier by reducing speed slightly.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: On a _____ -lane road, a driver being passed should move right as far as can be done safely.
cards.back: On a two-lane road, a driver being passed should move right as far as can be done safely.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Before reversing, check behind the vehicle and look directly through the _____ window rather than depending only on mirrors.
cards.back: Before reversing, check behind the vehicle and look directly through the rear window rather than depending only on mirrors.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Reverse _____ and remain ready to stop.
cards.back: Reverse slowly and remain ready to stop.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Walking around the vehicle _____ backing can reveal a child, pet or object in the path.
cards.back: Walking around the vehicle before backing can reveal a child, pet or object in the path.

decks.domain: Passing, night driving and age-related driving

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The first rain can make pavement especially slick because water mixes with oil and grease that have not washed _____ .
cards.back: The first rain can make pavement especially slick because water mixes with oil and grease that have not washed away.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: On wet pavement, the guide calls for slower travel, extra _____ and twice the normal following space.
cards.back: On wet pavement, the guide calls for slower travel, extra caution and twice the normal following space.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Slow, careful travel, particularly through curves, helps prevent a _____ on a wet road.
cards.back: Slow, careful travel, particularly through curves, helps prevent a skid on a wet road.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: If the car skids, remain calm, _____ the accelerator and steer carefully toward the intended path.
cards.back: If the car skids, remain calm, ease off the accelerator and steer carefully toward the intended path.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide advises avoiding brake use during its described wet-road _____ recovery.
cards.back: The guide advises avoiding brake use during its described wet-road skid recovery.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Hydroplaning occurs when the tires ride over a layer of _____ rather than remain in contact with pavement.
cards.back: Hydroplaning occurs when the tires ride over a layer of water rather than remain in contact with pavement.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Loss of tire contact during hydroplaning _____ the ability to steer, accelerate or brake effectively.
cards.back: Loss of tire contact during hydroplaning reduces the ability to steer, accelerate or brake effectively.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: To regain contact when hydroplaning, ease off the accelerator while looking and _____ toward the intended path; avoid braking.
cards.back: To regain contact when hydroplaning, ease off the accelerator while looking and steering toward the intended path; avoid braking.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Slower wet-road speeds, recommended tire inflation and good _____ help reduce hydroplaning risk.
cards.back: Slower wet-road speeds, recommended tire inflation and good tread help reduce hydroplaning risk.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Sloshing tire noise on a wet road is a reason to _____ speed.
cards.back: Sloshing tire noise on a wet road is a reason to reduce speed.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Never turn the ignition into its _____ -lock setting while the vehicle is moving.
cards.back: Never turn the ignition into its steering-lock setting while the vehicle is moving.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: At _____ , drive slowly enough to stop within the distance illuminated ahead.
cards.back: At night, drive slowly enough to stop within the distance illuminated ahead.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A dirty windshield _____ headlight glare and makes road users and signs harder to see.
cards.back: A dirty windshield increases headlight glare and makes road users and signs harder to see.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: For night driving, the guide recommends adding at least _____ second of following space.
cards.back: For night driving, the guide recommends adding at least one second of following space.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: On an unfamiliar road at night, the guide recommends adding at least _____ seconds of following space.
cards.back: On an unfamiliar road at night, the guide recommends adding at least two seconds of following space.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide _____ headlights, rather than parking lamps alone, from sunset until sunrise.
cards.back: The guide requires headlights, rather than parking lamps alone, from sunset until sunrise.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Use low beams within _____ feet of an approaching vehicle or two hundred feet behind another vehicle.
cards.back: Use low beams within five hundred feet of an approaching vehicle or two hundred feet behind another vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide requires headlights when precipitation or airborne moisture makes _____ use necessary.
cards.back: The guide requires headlights when precipitation or airborne moisture makes windshield-wiper use necessary.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Headlights are also required when weather prevents the vehicle from being clearly seen at _____ feet.
cards.back: Headlights are also required when weather prevents the vehicle from being clearly seen at five hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: If an approaching driver will not dim b_____ headlights, slow and use the roadway’s right edge as a guide.
cards.back: If an approaching driver will not dim bright headlights, slow and use the roadway’s right edge as a guide.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Switch _____ lights off when visibility improves; the guide reserves rear fog lamps for seriously reduced visibility.
cards.back: Switch fog lights off when visibility improves; the guide reserves rear fog lamps for seriously reduced visibility.

decks.domain: Passing, night driving and age-related driving

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A flashing do-not-walk signal forbids starting a crossing but lets a pedestrian already crossing continue to the nearest _____ area.
cards.back: A flashing do-not-walk signal forbids starting a crossing but lets a pedestrian already crossing continue to the nearest safe area.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A steady walk signal permits _____ to begin crossing toward it.
cards.back: A steady walk signal permits pedestrians to begin crossing toward it.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A pedestrian in a marked crosswalk or crossing with a walk or green signal has _____ over a turning vehicle.
cards.back: A pedestrian in a marked crosswalk or crossing with a walk or green signal has priority over a turning vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A driver turning _____ on red must yield to pedestrians.
cards.back: A driver turning right on red must yield to pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Be ready to _____ for a person in the roadway even when the person crosses somewhere improper.
cards.back: Be ready to stop for a person in the roadway even when the person crosses somewhere improper.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk because it may _____ a crossing pedestrian.
cards.back: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk because it may hide a crossing pedestrian.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Approach a stopped _____ cautiously and be ready for a person in a marked or unmarked crosswalk.
cards.back: Approach a stopped vehicle cautiously and be ready for a person in a marked or unmarked crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Slow near people walking or children playing beside the roadway and allow _____ for an unexpected movement.
cards.back: Slow near people walking or children playing beside the roadway and allow room for an unexpected movement.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A pedestrian should check left, _____ and left again before crossing and continue watching traffic during the crossing.
cards.back: A pedestrian should check left, right and left again before crossing and continue watching traffic during the crossing.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A pedestrian using a guide dog or a white cane, with or without a red tip, must be given _____ .
cards.back: A pedestrian using a guide dog or a white cane, with or without a red tip, must be given priority.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Use extra care when turning or reversing near a pedestrian with a _____ impairment.
cards.back: Use extra care when turning or reversing near a pedestrian with a visual impairment.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do _____ stop inside a crosswalk or obstruct the sidewalk.
cards.back: Do not stop inside a crosswalk or obstruct the sidewalk.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not honk at a pedestrian with a _____ impairment because the noise can startle or confuse the person.
cards.back: Do not honk at a pedestrian with a visual impairment because the noise can startle or confuse the person.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Before turning _____ on red, check carefully for pedestrians and other traffic.
cards.back: Before turning right on red, check carefully for pedestrians and other traffic.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A phone can distract visually by drawing the _____ away, manually by occupying the hands and cognitively by diverting attention.
cards.back: A phone can distract visually by drawing the eyes away, manually by occupying the hands and cognitively by diverting attention.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: If a call is necessary, have a passenger make it or pull off safely and stop _____ calling.
cards.back: If a call is necessary, have a passenger make it or pull off safely and stop before calling.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do _____ take notes or search for telephone numbers while driving.
cards.back: Do not take notes or search for telephone numbers while driving.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Let incoming calls go to _____ instead of responding while driving.
cards.back: Let incoming calls go to voicemail instead of responding while driving.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide describes a Louisiana prohibition on operating a wireless device while driving unless use is _____ .
cards.back: The guide describes a Louisiana prohibition on operating a wireless device while driving unless use is hands free.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide prohibits writing, sending or reading a text communication while operating a vehicle regardless of the driver’s _____ .
cards.back: The guide prohibits writing, sending or reading a text communication while operating a vehicle regardless of the driver’s age.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide prohibits accessing, reading or posting to a social-networking site while operating a vehicle regardless of _____ .
cards.back: The guide prohibits accessing, reading or posting to a social-networking site while operating a vehicle regardless of age.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide directs the reader to Louisiana Revised Statute _____ for exceptions to its wireless-device restrictions.
cards.back: The guide directs the reader to Louisiana Revised Statute thirty-two fifty-nine for exceptions to its wireless-device restrictions.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Peer pressure can encourage _____ speed, illegal maneuvers, careless steering or distractions.
cards.back: Peer pressure can encourage unsafe speed, illegal maneuvers, careless steering or distractions.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Turning to talk to passengers, racing and treating the roadway as a playground are _____ behaviors described in the guide.
cards.back: Turning to talk to passengers, racing and treating the roadway as a playground are unsafe behaviors described in the guide.

decks.domain: Passing, night driving and age-related driving

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Peers can improve safety by warning a _____ of a mistake and encouraging safer choices.
cards.back: Peers can improve safety by warning a driver of a mistake and encouraging safer choices.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide recommends understanding _____ and choosing safer travel conditions as driving abilities change.
cards.back: The guide recommends understanding personal limits and choosing safer travel conditions as driving abilities change.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Ask a _____ or pharmacist to review medicines that might interfere with driving.
cards.back: Ask a clinician or pharmacist to review medicines that might interfere with driving.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Use _____ glasses or contact lenses and keep vision and hearing checked.
cards.back: Use required glasses or contact lenses and keep vision and hearing checked.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When possible, select _____ travel and favorable weather.
cards.back: When possible, select daylight travel and favorable weather.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: _____ the route in advance and favor well-lit streets, controlled left turns and straightforward parking.
cards.back: Plan the route in advance and favor well-lit streets, controlled left turns and straightforward parking.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Maintain generous following space and avoid in-_____ distractions.
cards.back: Maintain generous following space and avoid in-vehicle distractions.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A refresher course can help a _____ update skills and knowledge.
cards.back: A refresher course can help a driver update skills and knowledge.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When driving is no longer suitable, consider traveling with a friend or using _____ .
cards.back: When driving is no longer suitable, consider traveling with a friend or using public transportation.
